label: Key Check
blurb: Shows how good a key is before you move on: the result over a checkerboard or a loud colour so fringes and holes stand out, the alpha on its own in grey, or the alpha with every part see through pixel painted in a colour, which finds the faint holes in a subject and the haze left on a screen. Put it last and turn it off before export.

params.label: Count as clear or solid within
